about: Cases for POST /v1/ops of the example cloud relays, from docs/cloud-relay.md. Send each operation in valid_ops alone, as {"ops":[op]}: the relay answers 200. Send each one in invalid_ops alone: the relay answers 400 with error invalid_op and index 0, and takes nothing. Send each body in raw_bodies as it is, with Content-Type application/json: the relay answers 400 with one of the errors listed. body_base64 holds bytes that JSON text cannot. A batch of exactly 100 operations and the photo size limit (1048576 bytes decoded) are left to each relay's own tests, to keep this file small.

valid_ops.name: pin with only the required fields
pin with dashes and underscores in the id
pin with a 200-character title of emoji
pin with accented letters in the title
marker with a color and a title
note with a line feed and a tab
photo, a PNG with a title
photo whose bytes start like a JPEG (the relay checks no more)
photo of only the PNG signature
track with one point and no time
track point at the lowest altitude and time 0
track point at the highest altitude and time
track with 100 points and a title

invalid_ops.name: title that is not a string
photo data in the URL-safe alphabet
photo data with a line break
photo data not as an encoder writes it
photo of PNG bytes called a JPEG
photo of JPEG bytes called a PNG
photo data that is not base64
track point with an unknown field
track point that is not an object
track point with a fractional time
track point with a negative time
track point with a time of 2^53
track point with the time as a string
delete_all, which the relay does not offer

raw_bodies.name: a number too large to be finite
an unpaired surrogate in a title
an operation that is not an object
